title: Green Come What May
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Jeremiah told the people
The words the Lord had said:
"The one who trusts Me is a tree
By living water fed."

[Chorus]
Send your roots down to the river,
Drink deep the whole day long;
Then when the hot, dry days arrive
Your leaves stay green and strong.

[Verse 2]
That tree spreads out her roots beside
The river cool and wide;
Where nobody can see her drink,
She's drinking deep inside.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So when the hot days come along
She is not scared at all;
Her leaves stay green, her fruit grows sweet,
Though not a drop should fall.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Like Beau, who fed the fish and sang
On one hard, rainy day,
Keep doing good, keep trusting Him,
And stay green come what may.

[Chorus]
mood: Root-reaching music. A slow, even pull under the voice, like water drawn up through a trunk one steady breath at a time, never hurried. Cello holding one long low note under each verse like the river, nylon guitar answering above it like leaves in a small wind. It stays level through the hot-day verse instead of rising, and ends greener and more settled than it began, bright enough for noon.
